items.name: bbox-layout
items.title: bbox layout
items.description: Portable layout geometry for black-box design components. Pure module — no React, no canvas engine.

items.name: port
items.title: Port
items.description: A circle with a text slot. Four states (Empty / Default Value / Wired / Data Recived), six text layouts, three diameters, three text rungs.

items.name: block
items.title: Block (Simple View)
items.description: The black-box Block in Simple View: Container, Header band, Glyph, Text slots, Chip. Icon rides the title rung at 0.9×.

items.name: block-node-reactflow
items.title: Block node (React Flow adapter)
items.description: React Flow custom node wrapping the Block; ports emit <Handle> DOM elements painted with the shared port-dot classes. NOTE: currently imports @bbox-ui/core, which is not yet published to npm — install the `block` item and repoint the import until it is.

items.name: block-shape-tldraw
items.title: Block ShapeUtil (tldraw adapter)
items.description: tldraw ShapeUtil rendering the Block inside HTMLContainer; shape w/h are authoritative and port anchors are geometry points. NOTE: currently imports @bbox-ui/core, which is not yet published to npm — install the `block` item and repoint the import until it is.
